Study in France

Well-known business and engineering schools, with a large number of master’s courses taught in English.

Enquire about France Find courses in France

At a glance

Main intakes
September, some in January
Master’s degree
1–2 years
Bachelor’s degree
3 years
English tests
IELTS or TOEFL for English-taught courses; French (DELF, DALF or TCF) for others
Visa
Long-stay student visa (VLS-TS)

Why students choose France

  • France’s business schools, the grandes écoles, are among the best known in Europe for management and finance.
  • Fees at public universities are set by the government and are lower than in most English-speaking countries.
  • A large number of master’s courses are taught fully in English, so French is not always needed to get in.
  • Students can work part-time while they study.

Popular subjects

  • Management and marketing
  • Finance
  • Luxury and fashion management
  • Data science and AI
  • Aerospace and engineering

Documents you will need

  • Passport
  • Class 10, Class 12 and degree mark sheets and certificates
  • English or French language score
  • Statement of purpose, CV and letters of recommendation
  • Admission letter from your university or school
  • Campus France file and interview (the Études en France procedure)
  • Proof of funds and proof of accommodation

After you graduate

Graduates with a master’s degree from France can apply for a post-study residence permit that gives them time to look for work.

Visa and work rules change. Your counsellor will confirm what applies on the date you apply.

Universities in France

See their courses

  • Université Paris-Saclay

    Paris region

    A public research university south of Paris, known worldwide for mathematics and physics.

  • Sorbonne University

    Paris

    A public university in central Paris for science, engineering, medicine and humanities. Most courses are taught in French.

  • École Polytechnique

    Palaiseau, near Paris

    One of France’s leading engineering schools, with a bachelor’s degree and several master’s degrees taught in English.

  • HEC Paris

    Jouy-en-Josas, near Paris

    One of Europe’s best-known business schools, especially for its Master in Management.

  • ESSEC Business School

    Cergy, near Paris

    A triple-accredited business school with a campus in Singapore as well as France.

  • SKEMA Business School

    Lille, Paris and Sophia Antipolis

    A triple-accredited school with several campuses and many MSc courses taught in English.

  • EDHEC Business School

    Lille, Nice and Paris

    A triple-accredited business school known for finance.

  • EPITA

    Paris

    An engineering school that specialises in computer science, with master’s courses taught in English.
